messages:
Jules (People Ops): Heads up — minor deadline shift for the SOC2/ISO evidence round. New dates below, please read.
Ana (Security): What changed?
Jules (People Ops): Privacy refresher deadline moved to 2026-04-08. Evidence upload final cutoff 2026-04-13 11:59pm PDT. Were closing collection early to give auditors extra review time.
Marco (Eng): Noted. If we already uploaded artifacts earlier, do we need to re-confirm?
Rhea (Compliance): If nothing changed, add a short note in the form: "confirmed - no changes since upload" and include the orig upload date. That counts.
Ana (Security): For logs: sending guidance doc here -> <https://redwood-internal/docs/evidence-guides#logs|evidence guides>. Please include retention policy references where relevant.
Marco (Eng): One more: can infra snapshots be a link to a GCS/S3 signed URL?
Rhea (Compliance): Yes, include signed URLs that expire after 30 days and also paste the path in the form. Reviewers will fetch before expiry.
Jules (People Ops): Were hosting two 20-min office hours Tue 9:15am & Thu 4:45pm in #people-ops-help if you want a quick sanity check.
sync-bot: Reminder: evidence-collection-check -> daily run, will auto-flag missing metadata :bell:
Ana (Security): Small ask: name uploads with the control id first (e.g., PRIV-01_policy.pdf). Makes reviewing faster.
Marco (Eng): Uploaded: PRIV-01, IAM-04 (links included).
Jules (People Ops): Please reply "Uploaded: <control ids>" in-thread once youve added things so we can tick the tracker.
Marco (Eng): Uploaded: PRIV-01, IAM-04.
Rhea (Compliance): Thanks Marco — adding to tracker. We may sample some items for deep review; if sampled, expect a 48h response window.
Jules (People Ops): TL;DR: privacy refresher by 2026-04-08, artifacts by 2026-04-13, use the evidence form, office hours Tue/Thu. Ping @Jules or @Rhea for help. :sparkles:
